summary: The rebuilt task is one coherent payment EOD restart/control incident rather than a collection of unrelated bugs. Its 29 observable manifestations are grouped into six causal clusters spanning replay identity, eligibility/capacity, durable resume state, accounting/reconciliation, close sequencing and database exactly-once boundaries. Those clusters interact through the same batch lifecycle, so plausible local fixes can leave downstream state inconsistent.

evidence.observation: Two-paragraph handoff frames one restart incident and observable publication/close outcomes without prescribing the repair.
Private design records 29 manifestations, six root-cause clusters and 27 causal edges; the failure graph is coupled around one EOD lifecycle.
One controller composes financial, population, accounting, capacity, integrity, restart, reconciliation, publication, close, operations and lifecycle modules into a single runtime path.
Restart authority and route-specific resume semantics are documented as operational invariants, not repair steps.
Reconciliation, publication and close form an explicit downstream control chain that makes partial fixes observable.
Large-system gate passes at 3055 substantive LOC / 29 defects / 6 roots / 37 tests; Oracle is 37/37 and NOP has the intended 30/7 split.

do_not_change: Do not add unrelated requirements merely to increase difficulty.
Do not expand the instruction into a defect inventory or step-by-step repair plan.
Do not collapse the durable resume, reconciliation and close phases into a single superficial success condition.
next_gate: Verifier Engineer, Originality, Difficulty Design, Compliance, Instruction and Documentation cold reviews
